cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wrote 'welcome for now.' Why for now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant you're welcome to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then now has brought an unnecessary suitcase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're reading too much into it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Too much is another interesting measurement of my welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your note says I'm 'welcome for now.' Should I unpack?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I meant until your flat's repaired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'for now' instead of 'until the repairs'? Is your welcome wearing out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cross it out. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But 'for now' was there before I complained. What happens when I stop asking?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'for now', but A5 switches to 'too much' instead of returning to that chosen phrase.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 challenges B2's omission of 'now'; A5 uses B4's exact language, although that weakens card fidelity.

relationship.evidence: B2 clarifies hospitality and B4 resists interpretation, but neither adds a concrete hosting constraint.

heightening.evidence: A5 starts a new wording complaint rather than deepening the original phrase's implications.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies a written welcome and B2 establishes permission to stay.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's suitcase metaphor is apt, but A5's 'measurement' adds another polished abstraction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'for now'; A3 and A5 keep returning to what those same words reveal about the durability of welcome.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 contrasts B2's repair explanation with the original wording; A5 treats B4's deletion as a response to complaint rather than reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers accommodation until repairs and B4 offers to amend the note, giving A substantive attempts at reassurance to reinterpret.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes even removal of the phrase evidence that welcome may depend on continued questioning.

specificity.evidence: A1's note and unpacking question establish temporary lodging; B2 gives the concrete reason: repairs to A's flat.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Is your welcome wearing out?' and A5's complaint distinction arise directly from the disputed phrase.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies the repairs explanation; A3 asks why that wording was not used instead of 'for now.'
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers to cross out the phrase; A5 distinguishes the original intention from an amendment made after objection.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The same phrase remains the basis of A's relational interpretation in A1, A3 and A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes editing the note insufficient and extends the concern to future unspoken withdrawal.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A repeatedly examines one chosen phrase as involuntary evidence of how conditional B's welcome really is.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General semantic nitpicking would move among interesting words without holding one phrase to its relational implications.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 abandons 'for now'; revised A3 and A5 both return to it, even after B offers to erase it.

records.recommendedEdit: The original breaks the one-phrase requirement. Added temporary lodging during repairs. Internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A1/A3/A5 retain 'for now'), logic 5 (A3 uses B2's repairs; A5 uses B4's erasure), relationship 4 (B clarifies and repairs), heightening 4 (A5 distrusts correction), specificity 5 (note and damaged flat), brevityWit 4 (A3 welcome wearing out). Total 92; applicable gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A's anxious interpretation overlaps with S92, but the sustained exact wording clearly supplies this card's distinctive mechanism. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 can sound knowingly prosecutorial; A must sincerely believe the original wording reveals more than the correction.
records.alternativeComparison: This interrogates a written offer and its amendment; the friends alternative interrogates a spoken qualifier and its claimed reassuring purpose.

cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're still friends. Still?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't quietly remove the word after I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a reassuring word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reassuring against what, exactly?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're 'still friends' while taking me off the pub quiz team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friends. We just need someone who knows sport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You dropped 'still.' Does that mean friendship's the consolation prize for losing my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come Thursday anyway. I'll save you a chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the team we're 'still friends.' I want to hear which word you stress in public.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'still friends'; A3 resists removing 'still'; A5 questions why that same word is reassuring.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 notices B2's shortened 'Friends'; A5 directly interrogates B4's explanation of reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2 affirms friendship and B4 explains benign intent, providing two different forms of reassurance.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's reassuring intention into evidence that the friendship faces a threat.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a friendship-status conversation through the precise disputed wording.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's short 'Reassuring against what' extracts the threatening implication directly from B4.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'still friends'; A3 scrutinizes B2's omission of 'still', and A5 requests the original phrase with public stress.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's 'Friends' prompts A3's omission analysis; B4's saved chair prompts A5 to test the phrase in front of the team.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants sporting knowledge on the team while preserving friendship; B4 offers inclusion, which A5 converts into a public reassurance test.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates A3's private wording inquiry into scrutiny of how B will stress the same words publicly.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes removal from a pub quiz team; B2's sport gap and B4's Thursday chair provide concrete social stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'consolation prize' links friendship to losing a team place; A5's stress test earns its humor through continued verbal suspicion.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 repeats 'Friends' without 'still'; A3 names and interprets that exact omission.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers attendance and a chair, creating the public setting in which A5 now wants the phrase tested.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A returns to one phrase and treats its omission and prospective emphasis as evidence of friendship's status.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands the same wording investigation to an audience without dictating B's answer or the scene's outcome.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A holds onto 'still friends' and repeatedly treats its wording as evidence about whether friendship has become a consolation for exclusion.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Resenting exclusion alone would demand reinstatement; A instead keeps examining what the same phrase says about the friendship.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 notices B2 dropping 'still' and interprets the replacement as a consolation; A5 uses B4's invitation to request a public repetition of 'still friends' with audible emphasis.

records.recommendedEdit: The supplied candidate review found no concrete occasion or consequence. Added removal from a pub quiz team and an invitation to attend anyway. Preserved firstPass exactly. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A1, A3 and A5 examine 'still friends'), logic 5 (A3 catches B2's omission; B4's invitation makes A5's public test possible), relationship 4 (B2 wants sports knowledge and B4 offers continued company), heightening 4 (A5 moves scrutiny from private wording to public emphasis), specificity 5 (A1 quiz exclusion and B4 Thursday seating), brevityWit 4 (A3's consolation prize links friendship to the quiz loss). Total 92; five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all dialogue gates pass. This is internal model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A3's inference from dropping 'still' is deliberately strained, but recognizable as A's sincere insecurity. No rewrite is needed.
records.writerReservation: B4 does not establish whether the saved chair is at the team table or nearby. A5's proposed public repetition must remain sincere scrutiny rather than a calculated humiliation.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved housing alternative interrogates a written qualification and its deletion. This alternative interrogates a spoken omission and then seeks public emphasis after social exclusion.

cards.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
cards.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Third time this week we've met outside the bakery. Fate's persistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live on the same street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It chose an efficient route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I come for bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fate knows how to keep you available.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Third time this week outside the bakery. Fate clearly wants us to catch up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live on the same street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. It keeps putting us within talking distance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm moving tomorrow. This is my last loaf here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it caught us just in time. Give me your new address before it has to start again.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls repeated bakery meetings fate; A3 and A5 reinterpret ordinary causes as fate's methods.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's shared street as a route; A5 uses B4's bread as the reason fate can find B.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 give mundane explanations but offer little meaningful change beyond resisting the same interpretation.

heightening.evidence: A5 restates fate's persistence without making a new commitment to continued contact.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes the bakery and third meeting this week; B2 supplies the shared street.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'efficient route' cleanly turns B2's explanation into support for fate.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats repeated bakery encounters as fate; A3 adopts proximity as its mechanism; A5 interprets impending departure as timely intervention.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's shared street becomes A3's talking distance; B4's move causes A5 to request the new address immediately.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a mundane explanation and B4 reveals an actual obstacle to future contact, changing A's objective.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts repeated chance meetings into deliberate address exchange because B4 ends the existing pattern.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes the bakery and third encounter; B4's 'last loaf' makes tomorrow's move concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'before it has to start again' gives fate administrative work while advancing the address request.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 attributes encounters to their street; A3 treats that arrangement as fate keeping conversation possible.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 announces tomorrow's move; A5 interprets the encounter as a last timely chance and asks for the address.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every explanation or obstacle becomes evidence that this connection is meant to continue.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 takes responsibility for continuing the connection that A1 credited to fate.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats recurring accidental encounters as intentional arrangements proving the connection should continue.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary eagerness to reconnect could ask for contact details without interpreting coincidence as proof of destiny.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 makes the shared street fate's arrangement; revised A5 treats B4's imminent move as proof the encounter was timely.

records.recommendedEdit: Preserved the bakery and added B's move to make the final interpretation consequential. Internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 credit fate), logic 5 (street informs A3; move informs A5), relationship 4 (B4 ends the recurring opportunity), heightening 4 (A5 requests future access), specificity 5 (last loaf before moving), brevityWit 4 (fate starting again). Total 92; applicable gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: The prior relationship is lightly sketched, but 'catch up' and repeated encounters make the pursuit clear. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: B's move is a substantial new fact, and the final address request should remain a hopeful proposal rather than assumed consent.
records.alternativeComparison: This responds to imminent geographical separation; the coat alternative turns B's cooperative travel suggestion into another sign.

cards.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
cards.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both reached for this coat. The universe wants us talking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And somehow my hand found your conversation starter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I have it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Let's see where the sleeves lead us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both reached for this coat. First reunion in ten years, and the universe won't let us leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's mine. Yours is still on the rack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it borrowed your coat to stop me missing you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's yours. Come on, we can share the taxi queue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats, now taxis. It's arranging this in stages. Where are you headed?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 interprets reaching for a coat as the universe arranging contact; A5 offers only vague continuation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's ownership, but A5's sleeves image barely develops B4's request for the coat back.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 establish ownership and a wish to recover the coat, with little relational history.

heightening.evidence: A5 does not specify what further connection follows returning the coat.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a coat but no location or prior connection; A5's 'where the sleeves lead' is hard to play concretely.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's conversation starter follows ownership, but A5 finishes on an image rather than a clear move.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 interprets the coat collision as cosmic intervention; A3 and A5 keep assigning purposeful arrangement to ordinary events.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's coat correction becomes A3's borrowed-coat explanation; B4's shared taxi queue becomes A5's next stage of fate.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the correct coat and B4 voluntarily extends company, giving A supportive material rather than repeated resistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 links coats and taxis into a sequence and asks B's destination, opening another opportunity for continued contact.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a ten-year reunion and simultaneous reach; B2 establishes the rack and B4 the taxi queue.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's universe borrowing a coat and A5's staged arrangements share one concise personification.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the mistaken coat; A3 makes that mistake fate's chosen means of stopping A.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 proposes sharing the taxi queue; A5 incorporates taxis into the supposed plan and asks where B is going.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A assigns continuing relational purpose to the coincidence, correction and shared departure.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands one accidental encounter into a multi-stage arrangement for further contact.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A reads an accidental coat mix-up and its practical resolution as successive arrangements keeping an old connection alive.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic flirting would use the coat as an excuse without treating each new circumstance as external proof.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 credits the universe with borrowing B's coat, and A5 counts B4's taxi queue as the next arranged stage.

records.recommendedEdit: Added a reunion and taxi queue to replace the vague sleeve ending. Internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 interpret arrangements), logic 5 (A3 uses ownership; A5 uses B4's queue), relationship 4 (B returns the coat and offers company), heightening 4 (A5 explores onward travel), specificity 4 (reunion and rack), brevityWit 4 (A5 staged arrangements). Total 90; applicable gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: Sharing a queue is deliberate cooperation rather than coincidence; A's absorption of that distinction remains clear and playable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: B4's invitation is deliberate rather than accidental; A's interpretation of that help as another cosmic arrangement must stay clear.
records.alternativeComparison: B actively helps prolong contact here, whereas the bakery alternative creates urgency through a move away.

cards.title: Fluent in Feelings
cards.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said fine while folding your napkin. That's guarded resentment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means the napkin was untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Order as emotional protection. Very clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop analysing me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've found a feeling with a proper name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said dinner was fine while folding your napkin. That's guarded resentment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means the napkin was untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're restoring order because you feel unheard. Tell me what you needed from dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: To eat without being analysed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good boundary. Now say it without hiding behind the napkin, so I can acknowledge it properly.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 diagnoses resentment and A3 corrects B's account, but A5 never prescribes the proper response.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 recasts B2's tidiness as protection; A5 treats B4's objection as diagnostic success.

relationship.evidence: B4 clearly wants the analysis stopped, but A5 provides another label without changing the interaction.

heightening.evidence: A5 congratulates the process rather than moving from interpretation to an imposed response.

specificity.evidence: A1's folded napkin supplies a visible, playable reaction to misinterpret.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Order as emotional protection' efficiently converts a mundane correction into supposed confirmation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 diagnoses napkin folding, A3 corrects B's literal explanation, and A5 prescribes how B must express a boundary.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's tidiness becomes A3's emotional order-restoration; B4's request to avoid analysis becomes A5's coached boundary.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an ordinary action understood literally and B4 explicitly wants an unanalysed meal, giving A a credible opposing need.

heightening.evidence: A5 subjects B4's objection to the same interpretive authority and makes ending analysis require more coached disclosure.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes dinner, a verbal reaction and napkin folding; A5 returns to that same napkin.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Good boundary' briefly appears receptive before turning the refusal into another prescribed exercise.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 explains tidying; A3 translates restoring physical order into feeling unheard.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks to eat without analysis; A5 identifies that as a boundary and prescribes its supposedly proper delivery.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A interprets, corrects and prescribes throughout, including when B rejects interpretation itself.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes B's effort to stop the behavior into its next object.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats B's reactions as expert-readable evidence, overrides B's explanation and prescribes how B should express the diagnosed feeling.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Merely naming emotions would stop at diagnosis; the exact card also corrects interpretation and dictates a proper response.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 replaces B2's tidiness explanation, and A5 turns B4's request to stop into a coached boundary performance.

records.recommendedEdit: Added prescription while retaining the dinner and napkin. Internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A3 diagnoses and prescribes), logic 5 (A3 uses B2's order; A5 uses B4's boundary), relationship 4 (B wants an ordinary meal), heightening 4 (A5 regulates resistance itself), specificity 5 (dinner and napkin), brevityWit 4 (A5 approves the boundary while violating it). Total 92; applicable spoken-dialogue gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: The language is deliberately therapeutic, but it belongs to A's fictional behavior and does not instruct the real performer. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's instructions are fictional dialogue to B, not coaching for the real partner; delivery should express sincere expertise rather than deliberate bullying.
records.alternativeComparison: This absorbs a direct boundary into further analysis; the biscuit alternative redirects an ordinary food request into emotional coaching.

cards.title: Fluent in Feelings
cards.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're laughing too quickly at that joke. Avoidance?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it was funny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Humour is often the front door to discomfort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you pass the biscuits?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seeking comfort. Which feeling would you like with them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're laughing very quickly at Dad's impression. Nervous about meeting my parents?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No, the impression was funny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's approval-seeking. You can let a joke pass without earning your place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you pass the biscuits? I missed lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Comfort-seeking now. Say 'I belong here' before you take one. Let's feed the insecurity first.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 interpret laughter, and A5 diagnoses comfort-seeking, but no clear proper response is prescribed.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 disputes B2's account of humor; A5 directly interprets B4's biscuit request.

relationship.evidence: B4 tries moving to a practical request, but B's desired ordinary interaction stays lightly developed.

heightening.evidence: A5 applies the same labeling tactic to biscuits without increasing the consequences of A's expertise.

specificity.evidence: A1's laugh and B4's biscuits suggest a social gathering with playable objects.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Which feeling would you like with them?' reads more like a menu joke than a sincere prescription.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 replaces B2's account of amusement with 'approval-seeking'; A5 diagnoses hunger as comfort-seeking and prescribes an affirmation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 interprets B2's enjoyment within the parent-meeting context; A5 specifically converts B4's biscuit request and missed lunch into an emotional diagnosis.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects the diagnosis and B4 seeks food, but B's practical needs mainly supply successive material for A's interpretation.

heightening.evidence: A3 advises how to react to jokes; after B4 requests biscuits, A5 imposes an emotional exercise before eating.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes meeting A's parents through Dad's impression; B4's biscuits and missed lunch ground the next exchange in an immediate need.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'feed the insecurity first' grows directly from the biscuits and A's interpretive confidence, though it slightly explains the preceding affirmation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 attributes the laughter to a funny impression; A3 corrects that account into an attempt to earn family approval.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks for biscuits because of a missed lunch; A5 interprets that request as comfort-seeking and attaches an affirmation to taking one.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A confidently translates reactions, rejects literal explanations, and prescribes allegedly proper emotional responses.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 extends the interpretation game into regulating access to food; the instruction belongs to the fictional interaction.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A converts laughter and hunger into expert emotional diagnoses, then prescribes reassurance instead of accepting B's stated explanations.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary supportive reassurance would respond to an expressed concern; A asserts hidden feelings despite B's corrections.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 overrides B2's explanation of amusement with approval-seeking; A5 recasts B4's missed lunch as insecurity requiring an affirmation before eating.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate confused ownership of the joke and padded its final prescription. Kept the introduced family visit, made Dad's impression consistent across A1 and B2, and shortened A5 to a specific affirmation before the biscuit. Preserved firstPass exactly. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 diagnose, correct and prescribe), logic 5 (A3 reinterprets B2's amusement; A5 responds to B4's hunger and biscuits), relationship 4 (B wants amusement and food accepted literally), heightening 4 (A5 makes emotional compliance precede eating), specificity 5 (A1 meeting parents and B4 missed lunch), brevityWit 4 (A5 feeding insecurity follows the biscuit request). Total 92; five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all dialogue gates pass. Prescriptions are fictional speech to B. This is internal model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A narrow pass. B has a credible immediate need, but limited influence beyond changing the diagnostic subject. The concluding metaphor is slightly over-explanatory; no rewrite is required.
records.writerReservation: A5's feeding metaphor remains polished, though it now directly expresses A's priority. A's behavior needs sincere confidence in helping B rather than conscious obstruction of hospitality.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved dinner alternative absorbs an explicit boundary into further analysis. This alternative recasts a guest's social response and physical hunger as insecurity during a family introduction.

cards.title: The Third Detail Matters
cards.instruction: Choose one arbitrary detail and treat it as the key that explains, controls, or prevents the entire impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that pebble level. It's the only thing holding Tuesday here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an ordinary pebble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why Tuesday trusts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I put it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On a level surface. Wednesday's waiting for a mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our ferry's floating above the harbour. Keep that souvenir pebble level; it's the only thing stopping us tipping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I picked it up for you. I need my hands for the bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it in my lunchbox. I'll keep the ferry level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your sandwiches make it tilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll flatten them into a level bed. Lunch can suffer; the passengers mustn't slide off.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes a pebble's level position responsible for holding Tuesday; A3 uses its ordinariness as supporting evidence.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly absorbs B2's ordinary-pebble objection; B4's request to put it down determines A5's level-surface condition.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants relief from holding the pebble, and A5 offers a constrained way to achieve it.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the proposed handover carry the risk of Wednesday exploiting a mistake.

specificity.evidence: A1 gives B a small object and an immediate holding requirement, though the surrounding location remains open.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's explanation of Tuesday's trust economically reinforces the arbitrary detail instead of introducing another object.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes an arbitrary souvenir pebble the sole safeguard against the airborne ferry tipping. A3 and A5 consistently organize action around keeping that detail level.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 needs free hands for bags, so A3 proposes transferring the pebble to A's lunchbox. B4 identifies the sandwiches as the source of tilt, so A5 proposes flattening them.

relationship.evidence: B2 reveals that the pebble was a gift for A and asserts a practical luggage need. B4 tests A3's proposed solution, making B a participant with useful objections.

heightening.evidence: A5 sacrifices lunch and specifies the danger to passengers after B4's sandwich objection. This develops the game, but the ferry-wide stakes were already established in A1.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a floating ferry and a level pebble; B2 and A3 supply bags and a lunchbox. The opening states the fantastic premise somewhat directly, but the physical task is clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's lunchbox solution is concise and usable. A5's willingness to flatten lunch earns its comic disproportion through B4, although the passenger explanation slightly underlines the joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's need to carry bags prompts A3 to take responsibility for supporting the pebble in a lunchbox.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals that the lunchbox contents undermine level support. A5 changes those contents by proposing to flatten the sandwiches.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 assigns the ferry's stability to one arbitrary pebble; A3 and A5 sincerely solve ordinary handling problems as matters of passenger safety.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 increases A's personal commitment by sacrificing lunch to the pebble's supposed control of the ferry, although the overall stakes increase only slightly.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A assigns an arbitrary small detail decisive control over an entire impossible situation and organizes practical choices around preserving it.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General magical superstition can accumulate charms; this card commits to one chosen detail as the controlling key.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 assigns the airborne ferry's stability to a souvenir pebble's levelness; A3 changes its container and A5 flattens lunch while preserving that single arbitrary condition.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the ferry trip, gifted pebble and lunchbox workaround, but replaced the ungrounded Tuesday claim with an explicitly airborne ferry in A1. This is a new illustrative impossibility, not a change to the card. cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've used this coffee machine plenty. You press here, naturally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the steam button.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, warming up before the main operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put a cup underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I was checking you remembered the sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's steam correction while preserving expertise, but A5 claims to test B instead of clearly learning the cup step.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's steam information; A5 acknowledges B4's sequence but does not say what A now does with the cup.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects a mistake and B4 offers practical help, giving A credible opportunities to bluff familiarity.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the expertise defense through 'checking you' without developing the coffee-making task.

specificity.evidence: A1 names the coffee machine, and B2's steam button makes the error immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'warming up' is an economical cover; A5's testing claim is more familiar and less task-specific.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 adopts B2's concealed controls with 'Naturally'; A5 learns B4's dial setting while claiming an established personal procedure.

heightening.evidence: A5 advances from knowing controls to claiming guest-specific expertise, but B4 adds another instruction rather than much greater pressure.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes coffee preparation; B2's flap and B4's dial provide immediately playable objects and tasks.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: A3 incorporates both steam and the concealed coffee controls introduced by B2.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies the default two-cup output and dial; A5 changes the dial and frames that correction as personalization.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's calm assertions disguise immediate learning from each of B's machine instructions.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 claims personalized mastery after requiring basic operational guidance.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D42 incorporates each newly supplied operating clue while presenting the resulting discovery as familiar procedure.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought dinner? I'll wash every dish in your house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only made soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll polish the soup spoons too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please just eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After I repaint the dining room. It needs to match your kindness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 overrepays dinner with all the dishes and A5 offers repainting, though restoring a competitive lead is only implied.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's soup to name spoons, but B4's 'just eat' does not specifically cause A5's dining-room repaint.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimizes the favor and B4 wants A to eat, but neither intervention changes the practical repayment tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 enlarges dishwashing into repainting, but that escalation is not earned by B4's request.

specificity.evidence: A1 and B2 establish a soup delivery; ownership and location become less clear when A5 names the dining room.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'match your kindness' explains the exaggeration, while the repainting itself could follow almost any favor.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 answers soup with a week of dinners; A3 doubles B2's freezer provision; A5 adds a larger freezer to regain the lead.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's already-filled freezer drives A3's reciprocal doubling; B4's tiny freezer and tubs both appear in A5's enlarged repayment.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an ill friend to rest and B4 asks only for containers; A turns this caring restraint into further competitive generosity.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates from supplying meals to supplying an appliance because B4 makes freezer capacity the obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1's soup delivery and B2's illness establish the relationship immediately; B4's tubs give the repayment a concrete form.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's bigger freezer follows B4 neatly, but 'That should put me ahead' explicitly explains the competitive motive already visible in A1 and A3.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals greater prior help and A's illness; A3 promises double provision after recovery.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4's small freezer prevents straightforward doubling, so A5 offers a larger freezer and returns the tubs full.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each of A's offers exceeds the favor just described, including turning a minimal repayment request into a major gift.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands competitive meal provision into appliance provision to overcome B's capacity objection.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D43 treats another person's help as an effort to surpass with a larger returning favor.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Excessive gratitude can overrepay kindness without seeking to regain the lead in giving.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 and A5 offer disproportionate favors; revised A5 explicitly seeks to get ahead through a larger gift caused by B4.

records.recommendedEdit: Added illness and freezer details to the existing food-delivery setting. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4's tiny freezer causes A5's appliance offer, making the escalation specific. Hard gates pass.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.text: Thanks for driving me. I'll cover your whole weekend shift.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Fewer introductions between courses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll want plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll serve sandwiches. This system keeps improving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 invokes guests from B2 without explaining the introduction saving; A5's sandwiches do not necessarily answer B4's desire for plates.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a broken dishwasher and dinner plan; A3 makes the resulting social arrangement harder to picture.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes curry service during appliance failure; B2 supplies exact guest and roll counts, making A3's intervention tangible.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies a two-to-one guest-to-roll shortage, causing A3 to halve the rolls.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 challenges the halved rolls' ability to contain curry; A5 invents cavities and thicker curry.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every obstacle becomes evidence for a newly economical preparation method.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 claims both containment and ingredient savings from the very modification forced by B4.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D44 treats each practical obstacle as evidence that another resource-saving routine can be invented.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Improvising a workaround alone lacks the card's celebratory claim that the inconvenience improves the system.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 links breakdown to shared-pan service; revised A3 saves bread and revised A5 saves both dishes and thickener.

records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. The bowl capacity is comic kitchen optimism; actors need not establish that the catering plan actually succeeds.
records.writerReservation: The serving plan is comic household ingenuity rather than a demonstrated recipe; the final line carries several related savings.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D44-single-a's sustained exercise reframing, this uses collaborative troubleshooting and successive concrete inventions.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you sure there's enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For everyone arriving, certainly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can bring food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No trouble. I've always wanted to know what hosting tastes like without eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't eaten either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4's delayed pizza becomes A5's plan to accompany everyone else's dinner before publicly eating alone.

hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns a helpful solution into a longer, more socially visible expression of the same inconvenience.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D45 preserves gracious accommodation while making the accumulating personal cost conspicuous.

mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 offers a portion and A5 announces hunger; revised A5 accepts B4's help warmly while exposing the resulting late, solitary meal.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.text: Another complaint for me! I'm becoming central to everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're complaining about you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct public engagement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want you removed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A strong mandate to discuss my position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for choosing the venue. I've narrowed it to my garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I preferred the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A lovely contribution. We'll use its name for a garden table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So I don't choose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've helped us appreciate how much simpler this is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 thanks B while restricting the venue to A's garden, and A3 warmly demotes B2's hall preference to a table name.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's hall suggestion directly; A5 answers B4's lost-choice question, but only through a general claim of simplicity.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes venue selection and a garden, while B2 supplies the hall and A3 a garden table.

heightening.evidence: A3 makes the garden more viable; A5 removes the competing reservation and tries to commit its money to the garden.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'You're a lifesaver' followed by cancellation warmly packages the decisive removal of B's remaining option.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 prefers the hall's rain shelter; A3 adds a gazebo to answer that concern within A's chosen venue.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 preserves the hall as a fallback; A5 specifically requests cancellation and commits its deposit to the gazebo.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A maintains appreciation while successively absorbing objections and removing alternatives.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 advances from favoring the garden to eliminating and financially repurposing its competitor; B can still resist.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D69 combines sustained warmth and appreciation with progressively removing the partner's available choices.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so grateful you're helping. I've assigned your whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered an hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such generosity deserves room to grow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not available Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for clarifying. Saturday will be delightfully full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'You're so careful' converts anxiety into qualification; A5's 'kitchen all to yourself' presents isolation as a gracious benefit.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's anxiety about china gives A3 the flattering rationale of carefulness for assigning precisely the task B declined.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 proposes that A handle boxing; A5 instead places the boxes beside B and leaves, eliminating the requested collaboration.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's thanks in A1, compliment in A3 and approval in A5 accompany progressively narrower choices for B.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A3 takes away task selection; A5 takes away B's proposed way of sharing the imposed task, while maintaining appreciative language.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.text: I'll open the storeroom in return for a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need a mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should be a modest favour. I'll name it later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I borrow the key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a second level of membership.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Behind the buckets. That's five minutes of cover; unlocking costs another ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lend me the key. I'll mop first, then cover your break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key costs tomorrow's break too. Today's cover pays for opening the door.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's modest mop need to describe a modest favor; A5 responds specifically to B4's key request as expanded access.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates to a second access tier after B4, but leaves its actual condition unspecified.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a locked storeroom, B2 names the mop, and B4 identifies the key as an alternative route.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'I'll name it later' makes the modest favor ominously open-ended; A5's membership metaphor stays tied to access.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 conditions unlocking on break cover; A3 charges separately for information and unlocking; A5 prices possession of the key in tomorrow's cover.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 requests the mop's location, which A3 supplies and bills. B4 requests the key, prompting A5's additional charge; the accumulated minutes become less explicit.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs to address a lobby spill, and B4 offers to mop before covering reception, giving B a practical priority and a bargaining tactic.

heightening.evidence: B4's key proposal prompts A5 to extend the obligation into tomorrow, increasing the price of solving the same access problem.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes reception and a locked storeroom; B2 supplies the coffee spill and mop. A3's precise minutes give way to broader break charges in A5.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's immediate charge for 'Behind the buckets' efficiently monetizes an ordinary answer; A5 sustains the access distinction but sounds somewhat like tariff exposition.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 attempts to obtain only the mop's location; A3 turns that narrower information request into a separate five-minute debt.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 proposes borrowing the key and covering the break afterward; A5 treats key access as an additional product requiring tomorrow's break too.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 attach conditions or debts to door access, information and key access respectively.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 responds to B's practical workaround by extending the existing favor obligation into another day, leaving negotiation open.

cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.text: Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That year apart was probably healthy for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We didn't speak at all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A thorough reset. No half-measures.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We forgot each other's birthdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now remembering them can be a fresh choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know how to fix us. First tea, then one honest sentence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just invented that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every established method had a first kettle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's step three?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll know after the sentence. It's a responsive method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly answers B2's invention charge, and A5 specifically accounts for the missing step B4 asks about.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies a concrete need after the shouting, and B4 protects it against A3's workaround. A5 grants B control of the pen while continuing to manage the repair.

heightening.evidence: B4's criticism prompts A5 to turn ordinary listening into supervised listening, increasing the improvised procedure and involving B in monitoring A.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes last night's shouting and a tea-based reconciliation attempt. B2 supplies the interruption problem, and A3 introduces the pen that A5 redistributes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Listening stage' and A5's 'Supervised listening' concisely disguise improvisation as a confident process; the humor follows each attempted repair.
